prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Final-effect game environment concept for the Chinese 2D prison factory game 监狱风云.
Input image 1: spatial and style reference ONLY. The red outlined empty old bathhouse site LEFT of the medical room and RIGHT of the dorm corridor is the location to fill. Generate a NEW clean concept illustration, NOT an editor screenshot. No UI or red rectangle.
Primary request: A compact modest 棋牌活动室 (chess and cards recreation room), designed for inexpensive production with two main square tables and simple reusable furniture. Prisoners socialize here; no elaborate game mechanisms, no casino.
Camera and composition: landscape image, directly overhead orthographic 2D game view with shallow visible furniture/wall front faces, same axis-aligned camera as source, no diagonal isometric view. The new room fills 70% of frame, all four room edges visible, cutaway roof so interior readable. Its location is left of medical room; show a small context strip of medical room on right with green tile walls and one blue hospital bed, dorm corridor on left, and unobstructed paved walkway along south. Preserve the room relationships and existing neighboring architecture; do not rebuild medical room. Single medium-small rectangular room, nearly square proportions, compact furniture relative to characters, no enormous empty hall.
Interior layout: TWO worn square timber tables arranged vertically with comfortably clear aisle between and around them. Upper table has a simple Chinese xiangqi board with round dark and red pieces, lower table has a small restrained spread of playing cards on a faded green cloth, no gambling chips/money. Each table has four low plain stools, with no collisions between occupied seating and circulation. Three tiny orange-clad chibi prisoners total: two seated at upper chess table, one standing beside lower card table, for scale. No portrait panels.
West wall: one long weathered wood-and-dark-metal bench with worn seat, sparse furniture. North wall: small modest wooden two-door cupboard holding a few stacked chess boxes and card boxes; next to it a simple pinned-paper noticeboard and small analog clock. Cupboard remains shallow and modest, no giant library shelving. Two small high-set dusty windows bring daylight. Southeast corner: one battered enamel mug on a small thermos stand and one dull metal waste bin, placed against wall outside circulation.
Entrance: centered SOUTH, one wide open doorway with matching blue-gray simple metal frame and a single leaf held fully open flat against adjacent wall, clear visible paved access from outside into central aisle. No horizontal lintel obscuring the doorway or characters. Modest physical room sign on south facade reads exactly “棋牌活动室”.
Art direction: hand-painted top-down 2D game assets with crisp dark outlines, textured aged materials, matching reference game. Restrained old institutional leisure interior. Warm pale plaster walls with faded slate-blue lower paint band, dark gray base, concrete coping, dusty gray-green square floor tiles, honey-brown worn timber, muted dark metal, restrained faded green cloth. Distinguish it from the green tiled medical room, but consistent scale and environmental realism. Soft warm daylight, small coherent shadows, slight wear and scattered scuffs, clean readable surfaces, not photorealistic, not vector.
Presentation: polished final layout concept. Thin cream top margin with title exactly “棋牌活动室 · 效果概念”. No floating labels, no arrows, no HUD, no surrounding editor panels, no neon, no luxury lounge furniture, no extra rooms, no billiards table, no televisions, no bookshelves. Keep circulation readable and avoid bare oversized floor space.
notes: Concept image for user review only. No game map or runtime assets changed. Board pieces/cards decorative in initial implementation; preserve access to adjacent medical room and south walkway.
